title: Mr. S—'s sealed letter
notes: Bible 6.1 quest 6: Mr. S—'s sealed letter, unreadable in the MVP beyond one line. Keeps the buyer's identity open (11.3 deliberately open). The invented line is for the owner to check.

pages.text: [illegible] the fourth is in Wendmouth and waits for the Tern. Keep the stone apart from the coin. [missing]
